authentication: HTTP Basic; username filex, password from the owner-issued WebDAVCredential. HTTPS required except loopback development. Cookie authentication is not accepted.
authorization: Exact webdav:<id> scope, owning account, active token/auth epoch and unfrozen draft; revalidated during writes and bounded payload reads. No cross-draft or published access.

methods.OPTIONS: 200, DAV 1,2; Allow lists supported methods. COPY is unsupported.
methods.PROPFIND: 207 XML DAV:multistatus; Depth 0 or 1 only; allprop, propname or requested properties, missing properties get 404 propstat. Empty body means allprop. XML body <= 64 KiB; complete XML response <= 8 MiB, otherwise 507 before any 207 body.
methods.HEAD: Same metadata as GET, no payload.
methods.PUT: 201 create or 204 atomic replacement after encrypted staging, checksum/MIME/scanner. Known Content-Length or X-Expected-Entity-Length, otherwise bounded two-pass encrypted staging. Maximum 1 TiB, no Content-Range.
methods.MKCOL: 201 for a new empty collection; parent must exist. Nonempty request bodies rejected.
methods.MOVE: 201 or 204; same origin and draft. Atomic file overwrite unless Overwrite F; collection overwrite unsupported.
methods.DELETE: 204; remove file or collection subtree from draft, queue encrypted payload cleanup. Root deletion forbidden.
methods.PROPPATCH: 207; bounded dead properties and timestamps, atomic 403/424 on protected live properties.
methods.GET: 200 or 206 for ready owner draft payload, no recipient consume. Conditional GET 304. Range is a single byte range.
methods.LOCK: 200 existing or 201 created empty file; exclusive write, Depth 0/infinity, timeout capped at 3600 s. Empty body refreshes the submitted active lock.
methods.UNLOCK: 204 with matching Lock-Token at lock root and credential.

errors.400: Malformed path, XML, header or unsupported partial upload.
errors.401: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked credential; Basic challenge.
errors.403: Scope, origin, transport, policy, frozen or unavailable draft.
errors.405: Unsupported method or MKCOL on existing resource.
errors.412: DAV If, If-Match, If-None-Match, If-Unmodified-Since or Overwrite F condition failed.
errors.413: XML, lock owner or upload size limit exceeded.
errors.416: Requested byte range is not satisfiable.
errors.415: Unsupported MKCOL body or content encoding.
errors.429: Shared concurrency limit of 8 streams, including all WebDAV methods.
errors.507: Draft tree exceeds 10000 nodes, response exceeds 8 MiB, or properties/active locks exceed their limits. Smaller Depth helps response size only; reduce draft metadata, release locks or split the draft.
errors.423: Required exclusive lock token missing, active lock conflicts, or draft publish while locked.

retry: Failed PUT preserves the old ready file; only staged candidates are cancelled. Expired staging leases are reclaimed by worker with hold checks. After lost success inspect ETag. Publish requires unlocked draft with no live staged files.
